福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

土地銀行臺南分行（原日本勸業銀行臺南支店）Tainan Branch of the Land Bank (Former Nippon Kangyo Bank)

認識這座 1937 年的銀行：勸業的意思、希臘式巨柱、牆上的吉祥圖案，還有住在騎樓下的燕子。

Meet a 1937 bank: what kangyo means, its Greek-style columns, its lucky symbols, and the swallows under its veranda.

在林百貨的斜對面，有一家長得像希臘神殿的銀行。它建於 1937 年，原是日本勸業銀行。「勸業」就是獎勵產業，銀行借錢給農業與土地開發。1945 年後改由臺灣土地銀行使用。今天它是市定古蹟，也仍是營業中的銀行。平面是三角形，風格是混血：希臘式巨柱，再加上日式與美式元素。仔細看，能找到吉祥圖案：古老的卍字、菊花，還有日本福神的臉。再抬頭看：燕子在挑高的騎樓天花板下築巢。樓下辦金融，樑上聞鳥語。

Across the crossroads from Hayashi Department Store stands a bank that looks like a Greek temple. It was built in 1937 for the Nippon Kangyo Bank. Kangyo means promoting industry, and the bank lent money for farms and land. After 1945 it passed to the Land Bank of Taiwan. Today it is a city monument, and still a working bank. The plan is a triangle, and the style is a fusion: Greek-style columns with Japanese and American touches. Look closely and you will find lucky symbols: the ancient 卍 sign, chrysanthemums, and the faces of Japanese gods of fortune. Then look up. Swallows nest under the high veranda ceiling. Commerce below, birdsong above.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 勸業銀行的故事1937 年，日本勸業銀行在臺南最熱鬧的銀座通蓋起這座新分行。In 1937, the Nippon Kangyo Bank built this new branch on Tainan's busiest shopping street.
  2. 混血的建築它像一座希臘神殿，沿路又蒐集了日本與美國的紀念品。It looks like a Greek temple that picked up souvenirs in Japan and America.
  3. 找找吉祥圖案與燕子站在柱廊下抬頭看，牆上和天花板藏著好多祝福。Stand under the colonnade and look up. The walls and ceiling are full of good wishes.

認識景點

About the place

勸業銀行的故事The Kangyo Bank story

勸業：「勸業」意指獎勵與扶植產業，這家銀行專門借錢給農業和土地開發。 1937 年落成：由銀行自己的營繕部門設計，東京的清水組施工。 變成土地銀行：1945 年臺灣移交中華民國後由政府接收；1946 年臺灣土地銀行成立，這裡成為臺南分行。 少了一排柱子：1983 年忠義路拓寬，西側的柱廊被拆除。

Promoting industry: Kangyo means promoting industry. The bank lent money for farming and land. Opened in 1937: The bank's own design team planned it, and the Shimizu company built it. It became the Land Bank: After 1945 the government took it over. In 1946 it became a branch of the new Land Bank of Taiwan. A lost colonnade: In 1983, Zhongyi Road was widened and the west colonnade was taken down.

市定古蹟：1998 年公告為臺南市定古蹟。 至今仍營業：它不是博物館，而是每天開門的銀行；營業時間可進去看挑高的大廳。

City monument: It became a Tainan city monument in 1998. Still a working bank: It is still a working bank. Step inside during opening hours to see the high hall.

混血的建築A building of many styles

希臘式巨柱：柱身有二十道直溝紋，沒有柱礎，學的是古希臘的多立克柱。 像埃及神殿？：也有學者形容這排厚重的柱廊像埃及神殿，各家說法不同。 三角形平面：建築平面呈特殊的三角形。 用石頭說「穩」：柱頭樸素又巨大，整棟樓都在說：你的錢放這裡很安全。

Greek-style columns: Each column has twenty flutes and no base, like a Greek Doric column. Like an Egyptian temple?: Some writers say the heavy colonnade looks like an Egyptian temple. A triangle plan: The plan of the building is a distinctive triangle. Saying safe in stone: Massive, simple columns tell customers that their money is safe.

洗石子：牆面用細石子做成，是日治時期的「平民版石材」。 斜對面的林百貨：銀行就在林百貨斜對面，當年這裡是臺南最摩登的街口。

Washed terrazzo: Walls finished with tiny pebbles were the Japanese-era substitute for stone. Across from Hayashi: It stands across from Hayashi Department Store, once Tainan's most modern corner.

找找吉祥圖案與燕子Lucky signs and swallows

卍字：卍是亞洲非常古老的吉祥符號，出現在簷口的裝飾帶上。 菊花：簷口有菊花圖案，騎樓天花板正中央也有一朵菊花浮雕。 日本福神：柱頭上方雕著福神的臉，替銀行和客人招財。 最忠實的客戶：挑高的騎樓天花板是燕子最愛的築巢處，常看得到親鳥餵雛鳥。

The wan symbol: The 卍 sign is a very old symbol of good luck in Asia. Chrysanthemums: decorate the cornice and the center of the veranda ceiling. Japanese gods of fortune: Faces of lucky gods look down from above the column tops. The most loyal customers: Swallows nest under the high veranda ceiling and feed their chicks there.

樓下金融，樑上鳥語：樓下辦金融，樑上聞鳥語，是這棟銀行最可愛的畫面。

Commerce below, birdsong above: Money is counted downstairs while the swallows sing above.

實景照片

Photos on site

轉角的柱列 The row of columns at the corner

從路口看這座 1937 年落成的銀行：沿著兩邊的街道，排著一長排巨大的圓柱，這就是「柱列」；柱身有一圈圈的橫紋。轉角上方的圓形標誌，是今天臺灣土地銀行的行徽。

Here is the bank from the crossroads. It opened in 1937. A long row of huge columns lines both streets. This is called a colonnade, and each column has rings around it. The round sign above the corner is the Land Bank's logo.

騎樓下的柱廊 Under the colonnade

走進騎樓抬頭看：一長排高大的柱子刻著一道道直溝紋，天花板分成一格格深深的方框。燕子最愛在這片高高的天花板下築巢。這種柱子叫「仿多立克柱式」：柱身有 20 道凹槽，柱頭有 3 道不同的花飾，下面沒有柱礎。

Step under the colonnade and look up. A long row of tall columns has deep grooves called flutes, and the ceiling is divided into deep square panels. Swallows love to nest up here. These columns follow a Doric-like style. Each one has 20 grooves, three different bands of decoration at the top, and no base.
